title: NFCWeb Tag Registry Interchange Schema
description: Canonical v1 interchange format for the NFCWeb NFC tag registry backup and migration.

format.description: Identifier of the data interchange format.

schemaVersion.description: Interchange schema specification version. Incremented for breaking schema changes.

exportedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of export generation.

appVersion.description: Application release version recorded at export time for provenance.

tags.description: Collection of NFC tag registry entries.

uid.description: Normalized or raw hardware serial number / UID of the NFC tag.

name.description: Optional user-assigned name or nickname for the tag.

firstSeen.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when tag was first discovered.

lastRead.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds of the most recent read.

readCount.description: Total number of times this tag has been read.

lastAction.description: Most recent action performed with this tag.

tagType.description: Hardware IC hint (e.g. NTAG213, MIFARE Ultralight).

hasNdef.description: Whether the tag has active formatted NDEF records.

records.description: Array of NDEF records stored on this tag.

isSample.description: Flag indicating if this tag is a simulated/mock sample.

data.description: Payload data encoded as text, URL, or serialized MIME content.

mediaType.description: MIME media type specification (required for mime records).

lang.description: Language code for text records (e.g. ja, en).
